result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I only ran the tests matching `*PurchaseOrder*`, and they passed. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example.

The change is in `countPurchaseOrdersIntoSalesRepRegionsPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the subquery's `WHERE`. This matches how the other per-rep counts filter. I also added a short note about cancelled orders to the method's Javadoc.

The query's structure is untouched. Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the highest count still comes first.

I haven't committed anything.
